title: iNaturalist Protocol for Community Projects
author: Leah Feldman
materials: Download iNaturalist OR click on iNaturalist webpage

steps.title: Access iNaturalist Account
steps.instruction: Create a new account or sign in to an existing account.

steps.title: Navigate to Projects
steps.instruction: Access the projects section of iNaturalist based on your device.

substeps.instruction: On a computer: Navigate to 'community' then 'projects'.
On a smartphone: Navigate to 'menu' then 'projects'.

steps.title: Join Class Project
steps.instruction: Search for your specific class iNat project title (e.g., Mo'orea ISP 2027) and join the project.

steps.title: Capture Images
steps.instruction: Take clear photos of the subjects you wish to upload.

steps.title: Upload Photos via App
steps.instruction: Use the iNaturalist app to import your images.

substeps.instruction: Either take a new photo or select the library icon to choose a desired image from your photos.

steps.title: Publish Observation
steps.instruction: Select 'upload now' to publish the observation to your account and the class project folder.

steps.title: Complete Observation Details
steps.instruction: Follow the on-screen prompts to add the location and species name.
